thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: 10+ OOM container restarts detected in us-west-2/gpu-pool over the last 3m. Error class: CUDA_OOM during prefill. Links: https://ops.internal/incidents/1728509991

dave-oncall: I'm on it — will triage now. Paging SREs. Who's on ML runtime?
alice-eng: emma is on ML, pinging her.

emma-ml: looking. Initial metric: prefill_kv_alloc_bytes spiked to ~48GB on a single pod, then container got OOM-killed.

bob-sre: logs from host gpu-07:
```
[2026-05-03T21:23:19Z] runtime: AllocKVCache(23348256) -> success
[2026-05-03T21:23:20Z] runtime: CUDA error: out of memory (cuMemAlloc) at /srv/runtime/alloc.c:132
[2026-05-03T21:23:20Z] kernel: containerd: kill container "inference-abc123" pid=1842 signal=9
```

dave-oncall: root cause hypothesis: unusually long prefill from a multi-tenant customer caused KV cache blowup + a noisy tenant sending many concurrent long-context requests. We saw tail latency spike and rollback attempts.

alice-eng: Confirmed: the incoming requests had recent client-reported context windows ~150k tokens (user-level). Prefill path attempted to allocate full KV for that sequence length.

frank-platform: gpu-hosts in the affected AZ also saw a node oscillation (kubelet restarted) at 21:25:11 — could be collateral. Node kubelet logs show repeated docker restart loops around same timeframe.

bob-sre: immediate mitigations applied:
- throttled prefill concurrency for affected tenant (tenant-id: T-12) via rate limiter
- enabled fallback routing to redwood-slim-v1 for that tenant
- tainted nodes: no new pods scheduled to hotspot hosts (gpu-07, gpu-08)
- restarted hotpool to clear stuck KV caches

emma-ml: also toggled aggressive prefix trimming on host-level: runtime flag --prefill-prefix-trim=10000 (temporary). This truncates prefill beyond 10k tokens for naive clients.

carla-custops: I'm notifying affected customers now. Which tenant list is impacted? Reply with CSV.

alice-eng: impacted_tenants.csv: T-12, T-43 (heavy chat sessions), T-77 (background ingestion). Sending via secure channel.

carla-custops: thanks. I'll send a targeted notice: brief outage, mitigation steps, ETA for full fix.

dave-oncall: status update: OOM restarts dropped to zero after throttles + fallback. System stable but degraded for impacted tenants (higher latency, smaller model). Monitoring to continue.

incident-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 (customer-affecting). Pager rotation: oncall->dave-oncall -> handoff pending in 45m.

alice-eng: next steps (short-term):
- persist temporary prefix-trim config across hosts (frank)
- add per-tenant prefill hard limit (emma)
- follow-up postmortem to review KV accounting and prefill memory bounds (owner: alice)

frank-platform: persisting config now to the fleet and pushing a hotpatch to the config repo. Deploy queued: rolling restart with config applied to one hotpool at a time.

bob-sre: ops note: we observed a node-flap between 21:24 and 21:27 that correlated with increased pod restart rate. We should include node-level health checks in postmortem.

emma-ml: long-term: consider adaptive kv-allocation (estimate tokens instead of full worst-case allocate) and add automatic model fallback when prefill allocation > 16GB.

dave-oncall: customer-impact summary for CS:
- window: 21:22–21:33 UTC
- symptoms: stream drops, container restarts, degraded routing to smaller model
- affected customers: small subset (3 tenants) that issued extremely long context prefill
- mitigation: rate-limiting, model fallback, prefix trimming
- ETA for full fix: patch + validation ~48–72 hours

carla-custops: sending update to customers now: ETA ~72h, will update if we have earlier estimate. Will request any logs from them if needed.

alice-eng: assigning owners: alice -> postmortem, emma -> runtime patch, frank -> fleet config persistence, bob -> node health triage.

dave-oncall: handoff: I will stay until the next duty rotates in 45m. If anything spikes, page me.

bob-sre: added temporary dashboard: /dashboards/prefill-oom-1728509991

incident-bot: Runbook recommend: https://runbooks.internal/prefill-oom — steps executed: throttling, fallback, restart hotpool, taint nodes. Marking checklist items complete.

carla-custops: :thumbsup: drafting customer message. Will post copy here for review.

carla-custops: DRAFT -> "We observed interruptions to model responses between 21:22–21:33 UTC due to large context requests from a small number of customers. We've applied throttles and routed traffic to a lower-memory model. We're working on a permanent fix and will follow up within 72 hours."

alice-eng: minor edit: add "no data was exfiltrated, this is not a security incident".

carla-custops: updated and sending.

dave-oncall: closing note: system stable, mitigation in prod, owners assigned. Will open incident ticket and link timelines + logs. Good work team. :party_parrot:

emma-ml: filing PR for adaptive kv allocation now: https://git.internal/ml/runtime/pulls/984

alice-eng: creating postmortem ticket: INC-1728509991-POSTMORTEM and scheduling blameless review.

incident-bot: Incident archived to timeline: https://ops.internal/incidents/1728509991/timeline
